findings.elementChain: route-level Suspense fallback replaces the whole shell
findings.repro: Open /visit cold on a phone profile; for 3.5-6.5s the page is a bare spinner with no header, no tab bar, no content (6 of ~90 loads hit it on a fast line)
findings.personaLine: I tapped Plan a Visit and the whole app disappeared into a spinner.
findings.direction: Keep the shell (header + tab bar) mounted during route chunk loads and give data sections reserved-height skeletons

findings.repro: Open /events at 390x844; the second visible grid row (days 2-7) shows a 27px sliver above the tab bar; centres sit under the bar, so the tap goes to the tab bar
findings.personaLine: I tapped a day I could see and landed on Gratitude instead.
findings.direction: Bottom padding or safe-area spacer on the calendar card so no grid row straddles the fixed bar at first paint

findings.elementChain: moon banner + EXAMPLE NAME badge + list item Gratitude cycle lunar-000330
findings.repro: Open /events signed out: the today chip reads Sturgeon Moon (example name), the month header carries an EXAMPLE NAME badge, and the list shows Gratitude cycle lunar-000330 ends, settlement is a human act after this
findings.personaLine: The calendar told me today is in Sturgeon Moon (example name). Is this place real yet?
findings.direction: Name the moons in config (or hide the marker publicly) and give system events a human title; the Stay page banner shows the honest-example pattern done right

findings.elementChain: NotFound card: red alert icon, blue Go Home button, no header/footer/tab bar
findings.repro: Open any bad URL: a generic template 404 (red icon, bright blue button) with zero Amora styling and no site chrome; Go Home is a JS button with no href; HTTP status is 200 (soft 404, round-2 deferred)
findings.personaLine: A wrong link dropped me somewhere that does not look like the village at all.
findings.direction: Restyle NotFound in the site palette with the normal chrome and real links (and revisit the deferred 200-vs-404 status)

findings.repro: Load each route on desktop Chromium; buffered layout-shift totals: 0.50, 0.45, 0.39, 0.36, 0.35 (poor is above 0.25); WebKit cannot measure the metric
findings.personaLine: The page kept jumping while I was reading it.
findings.direction: Reserve space for data-loaded sections (same root-cause family as P1-01)

findings.elementChain: gate renders the sign-in card while /api/messages still fires
findings.repro: Load /messages signed out; sometimes a 401 /api/messages lands in the console although the sign-in card is correct
findings.personaLine: (invisible to me, but the console says the page asked for my messages before knowing I am not signed in)
findings.direction: Skip the messages fetch until a token exists

findings.elementChain: #lyNow/#lyVision/#lyOrg/#lyFlows measure 0x0 in the iframe at phone widths
findings.repro: Open /map on a phone: the Now|Vision|Org|Flows lens band is not visible at first paint (the buttons exist and work when clicked programmatically); lenses reachable only via the map MORE sheet; the iframe interior document is 790px wide at vw 390 (+400 overflow, round-2 B8); the HELP tab shows a red 0 badge
findings.personaLine: I read about Now and Vision modes and could not find them on my phone.
findings.direction: Owner is the map session (grounds-v0.html): surface the lens control on mobile, hide the zero badge, and close the long-standing internal overflow
